why: Which Rukh a cast belongs to, for the Rukh flow of the Holy floors (docs/labyrinth/mega_flow.md): LIGHT magic is multiplied where the air is thick with Light Rukh and DARK magic is rejected there. Read by MagicAlignments (pure, tested) in this order: (1) 'exact' is a deliberate answer for one id (a magic family such as lightning, a spell page such as devil_union, a Tensura skill) and beats every keyword, because only a person can tell that Curse-Warding is a ward and not a curse; (2) otherwise the id is cut into WHOLE words (demon_light is demon + light, so lightning and lighten are not 'light') and a word in 'dark' or 'light' decides, DARK winning when both match because a half-demonic spell must not slip through the holy air; (3) anything else is neutral, which the flow ignores. The 'exact' families below follow the mod's own soul groups (the Light soul: Light, Lightning, Sword; the Darkness soul: Dark, Shadow, Poison, Eyeball, Curse, the four Demon magics, Demon Beast, Black Oil, Smoke, Soul, Soul Corpse) plus Blood and Anti-Magic, which the lore ties to blood and devils; every other magic family is neutral on purpose, and a unit test pins that table so a new family has to be placed here on purpose. A datapack that ships this same path replaces the whole file.
